info.title: daily.dev Public API
info.description: API for AI agents and automation to access daily.dev data. Free accounts get a monthly request quota; Plus raises it. Bookmark folders and clickbait-shielded titles require Plus.

get.description: Get feed with trending and popular posts

parameters.name: tags
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of tags to filter by (up to 20)

get.description: Get feed of posts with discussions

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: Days since publication to look back: 7 (default), 30 or 365. Posts are ranked by comment count within that window.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time range filter (day, week, month, year, all)

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query (required). Tags are lowercase hyphenated slugs such as "claude-code"; spaces in the query are treated as hyphens.

postIds.description: Array of post IDs to bookmark (1-100)

listId.description: Optional bookmark list ID to add posts to (Plus users only). If not provided, Plus users get "last used list" behavior. Non-Plus users: this parameter is ignored.

patch.description: Move a bookmark to a list or remove from list (Plus users only)

listId.description: Target bookmark list ID. Set to null or omit to remove from list.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Post ID of the bookmark to move

id.description: Setting ID to use when updating feed

name.description: Name of the feed. Letters, numbers and spaces only, up to 50 characters.

disableEngagementFilter.description: Disable engagement filter (when true, shows posts the user already clicked or saw in the feed)

locationType.description: Location type: REMOTE, OFFICE, HYBRID (work only)

employmentType.description: Employment type: FULL_TIME, PART_TIME, CONTRACT, INTERNSHIP (work only)

get.description: [EXPERIMENTAL] Recommend articles by keyword search. Best when the query contains specific technical terms (e.g. "RAG", "pgvector", "LangChain"). Returns posts with engagement signals for LLM consumption. Natural-language questions and long phrases usually match nothing and return an empty list; use GET /search/posts with two or three keywords for those. This endpoint may be removed or changed without notice.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query — keywords or technical terms (e.g. "RAG vs fine-tuning", "vector database comparison")

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of articles to return (1-20, default 10). Kept small for LLM context efficiency.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time range filter — use "month" or "year" for recent content, "all" for comprehensive results

get.description: [DEPRECATED] Use /recommend/keyword instead, which this endpoint now answers from. Kept for older clients and scheduled for removal.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Natural language question or topic (e.g. "how do I make my chatbot remember previous conversations?", "what is the best way to handle authentication in a Next.js app?")

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of articles to return (1-20, default 10). Kept small for LLM context efficiency.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: Time range filter — use "month" or "year" for recent content, "all" for comprehensive results

get.description: List approved plugins from the daily.dev marketplace, newest first. A plugin has an about page plus agent instructions (SKILL.md), a link, or both.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search in plugin names and descriptions

post.description: Submit a plugin to the daily.dev marketplace for review. Provide agent instructions (SKILL.md), a link, or both. The plugin is listed once the daily.dev team approves it.

description.description: Short plain-text pitch shown on marketplace cards, 1-3 sentences (10-300 chars)

about.description: Markdown describing the plugin, shown on its marketplace page (up to 20000 chars)

url.description: https link to the plugin homepage, repository or anything else

get.description: Get an approved plugin by id, including its about page. The SKILL.md is served separately at skillMdUrl.

post.description: Creates a daily.dev account from an email and password. No token required — this is the endpoint to call when you do not have one yet. Personal Access Tokens for the rest of this API are issued separately from account settings.

email.description: Email address for the new account

password.description: Password for the new account. Discarded on receipt — never logged or stored.

tokenUrl.description: Where an account owner mints an API token

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.0 access token for an app registered at https://daily.dev/settings/api. Request it with resource=https://api.daily.dev/public/v1.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the streak day boundary is measured in
